prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in League City, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1033; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a busy road in League City, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact pushed my car forward and I felt a sharp jolt through my body. I braced myself against the steering wheel and my left wrist took much of the force. After the collision I could not grip anything, and the pain grew worse over the next hour. I was taken to a clinic, where an X-ray showed a fracture in my wrist. I have since recalled a few more details about the moments before impact, but the core sequence of events has stayed the same from the start. I am the named driver on this policy and I am providing this account for my claim.
